scientific_integrity: Universal exclusion established by a self-contained cyclotomic prime-support argument; finite enumeration is supplementary, and no independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Excludes exactly the square-of-a-semiprime exponent pattern; does not exclude all odd superharmonic numbers or classify all two-prime supports. Originality is assessed relative to inspected and accessible sources; the full text of Luca (2004) was inaccessible.
title: No square of a semiprime is superharmonic
